facts: one SLIM matte black curved wand, about 15-16 cm, head a forward-tilted oval paddle barely wider than the handle, short black silicone nubs in rings
three moulded buttons on the front of the handle top to bottom: vibration icon ((•)), circle O, °C sign
wide flat silver chrome band at the bottom end (the heated end, 40°C = 104°F)
black stand, grey PRITECH on its front; the brush stands upright in it
no glowing bristles, no light effects; heat is on the silver end only
